data.title: PetVivo Sets Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Conference Call for Friday, August 14, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. ET
data.description: In Minneapolis, MN, United States, PetVivo Holdings, Inc. is set to host a conference call on August 14, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Eastern time to review the financial performance for the fiscal first quarter closing on June 30, 2026. The company, known for its innovative medical solutions for equines and companion animals, is listed under OTCQX as PETV and OTCID as PETVW. The official financial results will be disclosed in a press release preceding the call.

data.title: Sila Receives Conditional $1.4 Billion Loan Commitment from U.S. Department of War to Accelerate Domestic Battery Technology Manufacturing
data.description: Alameda-based Sila, a company specializing in advanced battery technology, revealed today it secured a conditional loan commitment totaling $1.4 billion from the United States Department of War via its Office of Strategic Capital (OSC). The funding is earmarked for bolstering the production capacity of Sila's silicon-carbon (Si/C) anode in its Moses Lake, Washington plant and constructing a lithium-ion battery cell manufacturing facility. The OSC's conditional support will enable the company to expand its operations significantly.

data.title: Primaris REIT Announces Distribution for August 2026
data.description: In Toronto, Primaris Real Estate Investment Trust (TSX: PMZ.UN) disclosed a distribution of $0.07333 per unit for August 2026, totaling $0.88 annually. The payment will be made on September 15, 2026, to shareholders recorded on August 31, 2026. As Canada's sole enclosed shopping center-oriented REIT, Primaris specializes in owning such properties.

data.title: Senvest Capital Inc. Reports Results for the Second Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
data.description: On August 7, 2026, in Montreal, Senvest Capital Inc. announced a significant increase in net income attributable to common shareholders for the second quarter of 2026. The company reported a net income of $415.4 million, equivalent to $171.49 per share. This marks a substantial rise from the $226.3 million, or $92.75 per share, reported for the same period in 2025. The sharp increase points to a strong financial performance and growth for Senvest Capital Inc. in the mentioned timeframe.

data.title: aTyr Pharma Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results, Program Prioritization and Corporate Restructuring to Support Efzofitimod Program in ILD
data.description: aTyr Pharma recently revealed their financial results for the second quarter of 2026. The company disclosed plans to prioritize their Efzofitimod program for Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD), alongside a corporate restructuring effort. This decision aims to allocate resources effectively towards the Efzofitimod program. The restructuring will involve workforce adjustments, budget reallocations, and strategic initiatives to drive the ILD program forward. The company aims to enhance efficiency and streamline operations to focus on the development of Efzofitimod for ILD.

data.title: EdgeConneX Supports Governor Abbott’s Leadership on Responsible Data Center Development in Texas
data.description: In Bastrop, Texas, EdgeConneX, a prominent player in customized digital infrastructure solutions, has endorsed Texas Governor Greg Abbott's initiatives to enhance transparency, infrastructure planning, and community protections regarding the establishment of data centers state-wide. CEO Randy Brouckman emphasized Texas's leading role in fostering innovation and economic growth. The company's support highlights the importance of these efforts in ensuring effective and sustainable development.

data.title: Cirrus Logic to Present at Upcoming Conference
data.description: In Austin, Texas, Cirrus Logic, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRUS) disclosed that CFO Jeff Woolard and EVP of Mixed-Signal Products Carl Alberty are set to speak at the KeyBanc Technology Leadership Forum in Deer Valley, Utah on August 11, 2026, at 11:30 a.m. MT. Those interested can access a live webcast and event replay via the company's investor relations site. Known for its expertise in low-power, high-precision mixed-signal processing, Cirrus Logic, Inc. is a key player in the industry.

data.title: Western Metallica Resources Corp. Announces Exclusivity and Binding Option Agreement for Nueva Celti Copper Project
data.description: In Toronto, Western Metallica Resources Corp. (TSXV: WMS) has finalized an Exclusivity and Binding Option Agreement with AJAX Resources PLC (AQSE: AJAX). This agreement grants AJAX an exclusive option to purchase all the shares of Western Metallica, S.L., a Spanish subsidiary holding the Nueva Celti project. AJAX has secured an irrevocable option to acquire 100% ownership of Western Metallica.

data.title: BTCPay Server warns users of critical flaw under attack, urges update to latest version and credential replacement.
data.description: A company specializing in Bitcoin, BTCPay Server, has notified its users to update their server to the latest version and change any compromised credentials. Users are advised to quickly install the updated server version and update their login details to ensure the safety of their accounts.
